editorial:
Imagine sitting in a cafe and making a wild bet that you will marry the very first woman who walks through the door. That is exactly how the story starts for a sea captain who is used to the lonely life of the ocean. You get to see him fall for a mysterious woman, but the movie quickly turns into a puzzle. It is not your typical love story because it jumps around in time and keeps you guessing about what is actually real and what is just a dream or a memory. The vibe is very dreamy and a bit strange, making you feel like you are drifting through a fog along with the characters.

You will notice that the acting is subtle, and the movie takes its time to build a mood rather than rushing through a plot. One big plus is how beautiful it looks, though some people might find the slow pace a bit frustrating. If you enjoy slow-burn dramas that make you think, you should definitely give this a try.
endingExplained: The end reveals that the story is mostly a reflection on memory and loss. You find out that the marriage was not as simple as it seemed and was filled with secrets. The captain realizes he cannot truly possess or understand the woman he loved. Everything wraps up with a feeling of sadness and acceptance, showing that some people are only meant to be in our lives for a short time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slow stories about love and memory.
